note: Native TFLite float32 MobileNetV2 vs the packaged TFJS engine. The TFLite model was converted from the nsfwjs 4.4.0 MobileNetV2 weights; scores match TFJS to 3.34e-06 on 12 benign views. Benchmarks are API 36 emulator, 12 benign views x 3, real model; no adult-positive images. Roundtrip includes preprocessing, native/bridge call and inference; not a phone benchmark.
